entries.title: Psalms 95:1
segments: Oh come, let us sing to the LORD; let us make a joyful noise to the Rock of our salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 95:2
segments: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to Him with psalms.

entries.title: Psalms 95:3
segments: For the LORD [is] a great God, and a great King above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 95:4
segments: In His hand [are] the deep places of the earth; the strength of the hills [is] also His.

entries.title: Psalms 95:5
segments: The sea [is] His, and He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.

entries.title: Psalms 95:6
segments: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

entries.title: Psalms 95:7
segments: For He [is] our God, and we [are] the people of His pasture, and the sheep of His hand. Today if you will hear His voice,

entries.title: Psalms 95:8
segments: harden not your heart, as [in the day] of strife, as [in the day] of testing in the wilderness;

entries.title: Psalms 95:9
segments: when your fathers tempted Me, tested Me, and saw My work.

entries.title: Psalms 95:10
segments: For forty years I was grieved with [this] generation, and said, It [is] a people who go astray in their hearts, and they have not known My ways;

entries.title: Psalms 95:11
segments: to whom I swore in My wrath that they should not enter into My rest.
